content: Language-based models which can detect causal explanations from everyday social media language can be used for more than automating optimism detection. Language-based assessments would enable other large-scale downstream tasks: tracking prevailing causal beliefs (e.g., about climate change or autism), better extracting process knowledge from non-fiction (e.g., gravity causes objects to move toward one another), or detecting attribution of blame or praise in product or service reviews (“I loved this restaurant because the fish was cooked to perfection”).
